policy.natural: WorldCover point and dominant 100m both vegetation/agriculture and no independent industrial reference <=5 km.
policy.other_uncertain: Insufficient/conflicting evidence or industrial reference only in 2-3 km review band.

worldcover_note: ESA WorldCover describes land cover, not the confirmed cause of a thermal anomaly.
industrial_reference_note: Facility proximity provides industrial context but does not independently prove an industrial fire.
